moderation.flash_not_moderator: That account is not an active moderator on this report's component. (The form may be out of sync — refresh.)
moderation.flash_unlocked: Report unlocked (C5 activated on the component).
moderation.unhide_desc: This restores the post to the feed — it was hidden by a moderator when the report was resolved. The action is written to the audit log.
moderation.unlock_header: Unlock (turn on moderation access for this community)
moderation.unlock_desc: This turns on moderation access for the community this report is about and marks the report unlocked. A moderator can then act on its content. Everything you do here is written to the audit log.
moderation.resolve_desc: This closes the report — it is marked as resolved, which is its final state. Everything you do here is written to the audit log.
moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.empty: No reports yet. The queue is empty.
moderation.resolve_note_placeholder: What happened, in one or two sentences
